newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore maintains 1997 GDP growth at 5-7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore maintains 1997 GDP growth at 5-7 pct.

text.p: Singapore's 1997 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is forecast to grow at between five and seven percent, unchanged from previous projections, Finance Minister Richard Hu said on Friday.
Hu said: "...the Ministry of Trade and Industry has forecast an economic growth in 1997 to be between five and seven percent," but added the figure was subject to review later in the year.
Hu, who was delivering his budget speech, said the optimism was due to expectations of a pickup in the electronics industry at the end of 1997 and good growth in the United States.
The smooth Hong Kong handover and a move to more constructive relations between the U.S. and China also contribute to continued growth in the region, he said.
